entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Ensure test coverage for `dotnet tool` when `tool` is present in CWD #52071
  • `dotnet build` failure when having `netcoreapp3` and `net10.0-windows` target frameworks and using `GetAwaiter` #52068
  • [ASP.NET Core] Audit usages of PreserveNewest/Always metadata to ensure support for IfDifferent #52066
  • TreatWarningsAsErrors not working under net10 sdk #52065
  • `dotnet run file.cs` doesn't detect changes through alias #52063
    10.0.2xx

Closed

  • In .NET SDK 10, compared to 8, publishing a single file as framework-dependent results in a significantly larger binary size. #52070
  • `dotnet build app.cs` should produce artifacts in the current directory #50227

PullRequests

Created

  • create a tasks-focused solution filter, and make repo tests more usable in VSCode #52072
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [dotnet-watch] Include AddExplicitInterfaceImplementation capability #52069
  • Fix dotnet-run-file up-to-date checks across symlinks #52064
    Area-run-file
  • Skip up-to-date optimization in dotnet-run-file when there are `#:project` directives #52062
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #52061

Merged

  • Separate command parsing from implementation to reduce dotnet-watch dependencies #51624
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #52060
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52033
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #52040
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.3xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #52049

Updated

  • Ensure that Trimming and AOT scenarios trigger downloading of necessary runtime packs #51765
    DO NOT MERGE, PublishVsBuild, Area-NativeAOT, Area-Trimming
  • Preserve UTF-8 BOM state in file-based app source files #52055
    Area-run-file
  • [dotnet-run] Implement `DeployToDevice` target invocation #52046
  • [dotnet-watch] Simplify logging #51307
  • Virtual project builder #52030
  • Fix CA1034 diagnostic when extension members are present #51773
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • realpath in c# #45637
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #52027
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52028
    Area-Infrastructure
